purpose: City Run sky and matching ambient-light concept previews; awaiting owner selection; different maps will have their own skyboxes

prompts.name: A — Clear Summer
prompts.prompt: Use case: lighting-weather. Edit target: the attached Roblox Studio screenshot of City Run. Create ONE polished skybox-and-lighting concept preview, keeping the exact existing camera, composition, low-poly Roblox geometry, buildings, brick textures, trees, platforms, pennants, and CITY RUN sign unchanged. Preserve the real game screenshot appearance, do not redesign or beautify the map, add geometry or replace materials. Change the visible sky and only the environmental illumination/color temperature needed for that sky. Remove the small Studio orientation gizmo in the top right. Landscape image matching the reference proportions. The sky should feel expansive, art-directed, natural but softly stylized, with detailed clean cloud silhouettes and a smooth atmospheric gradient, suitable for this colorful parkour game. No poster borders, no collage, no added labels or watermarks, no excessive bloom or blur. This is an in-context concept preview, not a cubemap texture. A clear summer late-morning sky: rich clean azure blue at the zenith, softer pale blue toward the distant roofline, scattered graceful white cumulus clouds with subtle cool undersides, plenty of open blue space. Modest cloud size and layered depth, no giant storm cloud. Crisp joyful daylight with clear readable platforms and vibrant but restrained brick/teal colors. A premium clean sunny city festival atmosphere.
